book.name: 1 TIMOTE
book.title: Mukaana wu a nsomo kundaa Timote

content: Ndagha yi yili yi a ngaŋma: Kala ti mbwuru dzyi okala mumbiri a libwunu li Nzaami, ekye esala ki ebwe nde adzyi.

Me mu obo, mumbiri a libwunu li Nzaami faana okala mbwuru wuulu ka baabagha ndagha yi baasyeme nde o, mulumu a mukaha yini a mutsyini, wu li a nzya-nzyara yi a faana ya yi a budziri, akala mbwuru wu aakuru nyuru ya wu li a nzya-nzyara yi mbwe, akala mbwuru wu akabwana a banzyi, mbwuru wu kughu oluo.
Anyaã okala enkolo-mala, anyaã okala a nzuŋu, lo akala mbwuru wu aakasa kuulu ti baara bakala mu eyiẽ, mbwuru wu aakasa ti baara bakala mu edzuunu ya wu gwene a ntono a nzi.
Nde faana otumu nzo a ndeme bubwe ya baana ba nde bafaana okala mu litumu li nde mu budziri bwohono.
Mu kuulu, kala ti mbwuru ka soolo otumu nzo a ndeme o, bunu a bo nde aatumu Libwunu li Nzaami?
Nde anyaã okala mbwuru wu munyaghara mu enzaami, mfangolo ligwagha lidzwi nde mihi ya nde somo mu mumfwunu a dyabulu.
Ofaana si ti baara ba bali ku mbala a libwunu basuo bumpughulu bu bubwe mu nde, mpaala baara banyaã otsaala nde ya nde anyaã okogholo mu myere mi dyabulu.
Bumõ si, basala ba Nzaami bafaana okala baara baba budziri ya banga a engaŋma. Banyaã okala binkolo-mala ya okadzyi busini bu baakabagha mu manzili ma mabi.
Bo bafaana okakebe mu bitsimi bibi tse-tse mansweghe ma kana ma ósuo Nzaami.
Nsomo, bafaana oluhu bo mu bigyeele ya ŋa nseele, kala ti ka babagha ndagha yi baasyeme bo o, bo bakughu osala esala e Nzaami.
Bakaha si bafaana okala baba budziri, ba bagwene a makuhu, ba bali a nzya-nzyara yi faana ya yi a budziri. Bo bafaana okala baara baala mu nswe ndagha bakughu osa kana mu bo.
Musala a Nzaami faana okala a mukala yini a mutsyini, ya nde faana okatumu baana ya nzo a nde bubwe.
Mu kuulu, baara ba baakasala esala e Nzaami bubwe, sa bagwa bo budziri ya bo sa bakala a emiini ki elagha mu kana li lili mu Yiisu-Kriste.
Me nsono we mandagha ma mu emiini kiili ti edzi-dzighi me sa ngyamono we.
Lo kala ti me ka mbaangya o, we sa soolo bunu a bo we aadzyara munsa nzo a Nzaami, yili Libwunu li Nzaami wu a mweẽ, kwii li linene ya li ookasiŋi engaŋma.
Ya oli ngaŋma ti mansweghe ma mpaana a enzaami mali ma manene:

content.text: bási nde mbwuru wu bunsumu mu Mufulu a Ngili,
bátsala nsia a nde kundaa bikaana byehene,
baara ba nsie bási kana mu nde,
Bágyene a nde ku yulu munsa nsia.
